title: A Space website's visitors are served a cached copy that refreshes when the owner saves or publishes, instead of a fresh server render on every visit

source.ref: PROG-E10 phase 5 of the white label sites build (ADR-1708); lift report /mnt/project-files/white-label/2026-10-06-lift-report.md

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 as phase 5 of the white label sites build (ADR-1708). THE CONSEQUENCE: all four site routes (app/sites/[slug], its [page], app/hosted/[host], its [page]) were force-dynamic, so every visit to a Space website was a function invocation and a fresh read of rows that change only when the owner saves, the Vercel cost the lift report flags. THE FIX, the repo's existing patterns rather than a new one: the routes are ISR like app/(public) (revalidate plus an empty generateStaticParams, markAnonymousRender first so no viewer read on the ~280-module render can reach cookies), and the Space row that decides the site (publish flag, pages, page docs, brand) is read through the cross-request seam (lib/cross-request-cache.ts, unstable_cache) under a per-Space tag site:<slug>, via getPublicSpaceBySlugOrThrow (throws on a failed read so a fallback is never cached). Under ISR the tag rides onto every cached page of the site, on /sites/<slug> and on the Space's own domain alike. refreshSite(slug) (lib/sites/site-cache.ts: invalidateCacheTag, which is updateTag in a Server Action, so read-your-own-writes, plus revalidatePath of /sites/<slug>) is called beside publishSpaceLanding and resetSpaceLanding, setWebsitePublished, connectSiteDomain and removeSiteDomain (which also revalidate /hosted/<domain>), and every profile-wide Page panel write, so an unpublish takes the site down on the next request. The hosted route no longer reads the Host header (which forced per-request rendering): routeSiteHost answers not-found for /hosted on Frequency's own hosts, so the site is still never served twice. The cross-request census test lists the new cached source. A write that skips refreshSite is bounded by the seam's ten-minute ceiling.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const routes=['app/sites/[slug]/page.tsx','app/sites/[slug]/[page]/page.tsx','app/hosted/[host]/page.tsx','app/hosted/[host]/[page]/page.tsx'];for(const p of routes){const s=r(p);if(/force-dynamic/.test(s)||!/export const revalidate = [0-9]+/.test(s)||!/generateStaticParams/.test(s)||!/markAnonymousRender\(\)/.test(s))miss.push(p+' still renders on every visit')}const cache=r('lib/sites/site-cache.ts');if(!/crossRequestCached\([^)]*tags:\s*\[siteCacheTag\(/.test(cache)||!/invalidateCacheTag\(siteCacheTag\(slug\)\)/.test(cache))miss.push('the site Space read is not cached under a per-Space tag that refreshSite expires');if(!/getSiteSpace\(slug\)/.test(r('components/sites/site-page.tsx')))miss.push('the site render does not read through the cached seam');const pub=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/layout/actions.ts');const a=pub.indexOf('export async function setWebsitePublished(');if(a<0||!/refreshSite\(slug\)/.test(pub.slice(a,pub.indexOf('\n}',a))))miss.push('publishing or unpublishing does not refresh the cached site');if(((r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/edit-page/actions.ts').match(/refreshSite\(slug\)/g))||[]).length<2)miss.push('saving a page doc does not refresh the cached site');if(/headers\(/.test(r('lib/sites/hosted.ts'))||!/isHostedPath\(pathname\)\s*\?\s*\{\s*kind:\s*'not-found'/.test(r('lib/sites/host.ts')))miss.push('the hosted route still reads the Host header, or /hosted is not kept off the app host');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-784: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Measures the consequence at each seam: none of the four site routes is force-dynamic and each is ISR with an anonymous render, the site's Space read is cached under a per-Space tag that refreshSite expires, the site render reads through it, publishing and page-doc saves call refreshSite, and the hosted route no longer reads the Host header while the proxy keeps /hosted off Frequency's host. Failed on main and on the LIVE-783 branch before this change (all four routes were force-dynamic and nothing was cached).
